about_the_game:
Build your exotic pet shop

In Exotica Pet Shop Simulator 2 – Demo, you'll take your first steps toward running a cozy pet shop full of unique animals and happy customers. Design your shop layout, manage resources, and create a welcoming space for pets and people.

Take care of your animals

Feed, grow, and care for a selection of pets, including birds, reptiles, fish, and more. Breed animals when possible, and discover new species along the way. Happy animals make for happy customers—and a stronger reputation.

Manage, decorate, and expand

Use construction and decoration tools to build and customize your store. Paint walls and floors, place outdoor plants, install lighting, and make your shop feel alive. Hire one employee to help manage animal care, cashier duties, or stock control.

Included in this demo:

Available animals:

  • 3 cichlid species

  • Budgerigar

  • Fancy rat

  • Orange cat

  • Gecko

Available stands:

  • Small and medium aquarium stands

  • Small bird stand

  • Rodent stand

  • Large terrarium stand

  • Food and accessory stands

  • Storage shelf

Available construction items:

  • Doors, windows, walls, and floor paints

  • Roadways, signboards, lamps ,and  wall ornaments

  • Indoor/outdoor plants

  • Cat bed, food bowl, and cashier counter

  • Dumpster

Other features:

  • Hire 1 employee with multiple roles (animal care, cashier, storage)

  • Credit system available

Customer satisfaction is everything

If you keep your visitors happy, they’ll reward you with positive reviews and a growing shop reputation. More reputation means more customers and more animals getting adopted into loving homes.
